dataset: NASA Preprocessed Soil Moisture Climatology & Anomalies
spatial_resolution: 9 km (SMAP L4 grid / GMAO MERRA-2 assimilation)

depths_represented.surface: 0-5 cm soil layer (seed germination / surface crusting)
depths_represented.rootzone: 0-100 cm profile depth (active crop root water uptake)

soil_conversion: Volumetric moisture calculated using characteristic porosity theta_sat = 0.43 m^3/m^3 for Ejura Ochrosols
